## Before submitting checklist

- [ ] Does the title follow the conventional format: `<type>(<optional scope>)<optional !>: <description>`.
    Valid types are feat, fix, chore, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, ci, build, or revert, and the optional ! denotes breaking changes.
- [ ] Did you **update the CHANGELOG**? (not for test updates, internal changes/refactors or CI/CD setup)
- [ ] Did you add tests to cover your changes? (if applicable)
